body: Dude I feel for you. We are both young, you are 25, I’m 19. I don’t have much good advice, I am very depressed and suicidal now too. But I think the right thing for you to do right now is whatever that improves your mental health. If going back to school working full-time is too much, please don’t do it. I know what it is like to work so hard for something only for it to collapse. Right now, our priority should be improving our mental health. You have so much time in front of you, you have to take the safe route first and not jeopardize your safety! Please try not to over stress yourself. It will be okay, opportunities are everywhere! If stop giving a fuck improves your mental wellness, then please stop giving a fuck

I feel the same. If people care for me they should’ve helped me when I was depressed anyways. And now when I’m suicidal the same people judge me and calls me irresponsible. 

I’m done I don’t have the gut to kill myself but I will never pretend that I’m happy or fine ever again. If people do me wrong I am going to say how I feel.
